name: orchestrate-kit
description: Tech-lead orchestration for Claude Code: diagnose, cut work orders, dispatch Opus executors, verify, risk-graded review, adjudicate, close. Ships risk-grade / risk-calibrate, debug-by-evidence, executable-spec, role-ui-walkthrough (usability walkthrough by screen-only role agents), gap-adjudication-report and the executor / reviewer / verifier agents, plus bundled hooks that snapshot the working tree before each executor dispatch and remind the session to re-read rules after compaction.
